components.name: Tenant / SRE
components.note: Tenants request clusters and changes; SREs operate the platform.

components.name: Wingman portal
components.note: Live on the sandbox. Workflow-backed create, upgrades and add-servers are behind flags, off by default. No tenant role yet.

components.name: Temporal orchestrator
components.note: The brain, the per-domain workers and the trigger API.

components.name: add-server-to-mce
components.note: Bare metal done; the draw comes from the InfraEnv's agentLabels. Not yet: the create-vm child for VM pools (AD29), the zone in the draw, and the installed-by and VM labels on its objects (AD37).

components.name: remove-server-from-mce
components.note: BareMetalHost and NMStateConfig deleted, metal3 powering the host off; Agent; PXE entries. Not yet: deleting a VM server's VM as its last step (AD36).

components.name: uninstall-server-from-hc
components.note: Takes a node out of its hosted cluster, then removes the server from the MCE through its remove-server-from-mce child.

components.name: publish-infraenv-to-pxe
components.note: publish-infraenv-to-pxe-server: republishes an InfraEnv's boot entry.

components.name: provision-dell-server
components.note: Built; its worker is not deployed.

components.name: segment workflows
components.note: initialize-segment, allocate-segment, release-segment.

components.name: provision-cluster
components.note: On main; its worker chart is not yet deployed, and Wingman's switch to it is off by default.

components.name: update-nodepool
components.note: Merged to main: sets a NodePool's replicas; a scale-down marks the Machines that leave, by name or by policy. Not yet: creating a missing NodePool, for the KV Capacity Controller's standby.

components.name: create-vm
components.note: On main, its deployment still to be confirmed: the zone lock, the oldest KV cluster that fits, a worker in each KV cluster, serial names, KubeMacPool's MAC, a failed create moving on. Not yet: started as add-server-to-mce's child (AD29), and the kv-cluster label.

components.name: KV zone lock
components.note: On main: one create-vm run at a time chooses a KV cluster in a zone (AD32). Its deployment is still to be confirmed.

components.name: delete-stray-vm
components.note: On main: removes a VM that a create-vm run left on a cluster it moved on from, by its run-id label. Its deployment is still to be confirmed.

components.name: upgrade-cluster
components.note: Sandbox only, not production.

components.name: deprovision-cluster
components.note: Planned. Today an ArgoCD PostDelete hook releases the segment.

lanes.title: Desired state
lanes.subtitle: Git holds it, ArgoCD applies it

components.name: day1 repo
components.note: One file per hosted cluster: NodePools, versions, network.

components.name: day2 sig repos
components.note: Per-team add-ons on every cluster kind.

components.name: hostedclusters-setup
components.note: Not yet rendered: the redbull.io/claimed exclusion, InfraEnv agentLabels, zone nodeLabels. NodePool annotations: PR #4 open.

components.name: ArgoCD
components.note: The only applicator of desired state.

components.name: Capacity policy file
components.note: AD31: the ConfigMap capacity-policy, with maxNodes, freeCpuPercent, growAtCpuPercent, standbyWorkers and standbyClusters, read by placement and the KV Capacity Controller.

lanes.title: Clusters
lanes.subtitle: Where control planes and workers run

components.name: Customer MCE hubs
components.note: Tenant hubs running HyperShift and the Agent installer.

components.name: Tenant hosted clusters
components.note: Hosted control planes on the MCE; workers from InfraEnv pools.

components.name: Seed clusters
components.note: At least one bare-metal seed per zone (AD17). Its day1 folders do not exist yet.

components.name: KV clusters
components.note: Proven in the lab only.

components.name: vm-lifecycle-worker
components.note: On main: a worker inside each KV cluster, on that cluster's own queue, reads its figures and creates and deletes VMs. KubeMacPool assigns MACs, so its chart is the same on every KV cluster. Its deployment is still to be confirmed.

components.name: kubevirt-redfish
components.note: Exposes each VM as a Redfish system, so it installs like bare metal.

components.name: Node bin-packing
components.note: AD30: HighNodeUtilization and CompactAndScale. Not confirmed on any KV cluster.

components.name: server-scan
components.note: Inventory of record, install lock, zone from the ACI leaf.

components.name: segments-manager
components.note: Per-site VLAN segments and who holds them.

components.name: DHCP scope manager
components.note: DHCP scopes, created by Crossplane from day1.

components.name: PXE map API
components.note: Boot entries for servers without virtual media.

components.name: Cisco ACI
components.note: The physical leaf a server is cabled to gives its zone.

components.name: Inventory Controller
components.note: herzi: built, in dry run on every pool, never run against a real hub.

components.name: Used-Agent collector
components.note: AD34: collects claimed, unbound Agents through remove-server-from-mce. Proposed in herzi#1.

components.name: Claimed-Agent tagging
components.note: AD34: herzi labels every bound Agent redbull.io/claimed.

components.name: KV Capacity Controller
components.note: AD27, AD28, AD35: grows each KV NodePool from 70% requested CPU, up to 40 nodes a cluster, and keeps an empty standby. Specification only.
